note: Every licence field below was read on the official CSLB licence-detail page for that licence number on 2026-11-07; the record for each licence prints its own data-current timestamp. Yelp figures are third-party snapshots captured the same day (see flags F12 and F13).

groups.title: Table 1 — The three companies that quoted the job
groups.sub: All three hold an active C-36 Plumbing licence on the official CSLB record (data current 11/7/2026). Quote amounts are owner-provided: no official source publishes them.

groups.title: Table 2 — Single-contract candidates: General Building (B) plus Plumbing (C-36) on one licence
groups.sub: This is the requirement that narrows the field. Under Business & Professions Code §7057 a general building contractor's scope covers projects requiring at least two unrelated trades or crafts; a firm that also holds C-36 can take the plumbing itself, so one contract can cover opening the ceiling, the repair, and the patch.

groups.title: Table 3 — Additional licensed plumbing candidates (C-36 only)
groups.sub: These firms can do the plumbing but hold no B General Building classification, so the drywall portion would have to be subcontracted by them or handled on a separate contract.
